DOP: araṇī̆ f. [ S. araṇi], one of the two pieces of wood (usually the lower) used for kindling fire ; Abh 419; Ja IV 290, 20 (~iṃ manthetvā aggiṃ nibbattetvā); Ap 303, 20 ; Mil 53, 29 (~i na siyā °-potako na siyā °-yottakaṃ na siyā uttarāraṇi na siyā); Spk II 101, 32 (dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānan ti dvinnaṃ ~īnaṃ); — ifc see adharâ-, uttarâ-; — °(i)- dhanuka , n. , a sort of bow used with the kindling stick ; Sp 292, 27 ; 883, 28 ; — °(ī)- nara , m. , a man with kindling sticks ; Ja VI 206, 19* (nāmatthamāno ~ena … jāyati jātavedo; 209, 21´ : nāpi ~ena araṇihatthena narena amanthiyamāno nibbattati); — °(i)- potaka , m. , a twirling stick ; Mil 53, 29 ; — °(i)- yottaka , n. , a cord for the twirling stick ; Mil 53, 30 ; — °(ī̆)- sahita , n. , the fire implements; the kindling sticks ; Vin II 217, 1 (na aggiṃ upaṭṭhāpenti na ~aṃ upaṭṭhāpenti; Ja I 212, 15 (~aṃ nīharitvā aggiṃ karonti); Sp 758, 27 (~ena aggiṃ nibbattetvā); — ~âbhimatthana, n. , twirling, rubbing together, the kindling sticks ; Vism 583, 14 .
CPD: araṇ[ī/i] , f . [ ts .], either of the two pieces of wood for making fire ( but generally = adharâraṇī); Abh 419 ( m. & f., from Am-k ll 7, 19 ); nom. ~i na siyā, Mil 53, 29 (+ araṇi-potaka, araṇi-yottaka, uttarâraṇi, coḷaka, parts of the araṇīsahita; = gini-gāna yaṭa-līya, Hīnaṭ); acc. ~iṃ manthetvā ( caus. ) aggiṃ nibbattetvā, Ja lV 290, 20 (= araṇiyā, pt); ~iṃ manthento ( C e °anto), Ps ll 253, 29 ; acc. pl. ~ī, Ap 303, 20 ; gen. pl. dvinnaṃ ~īnaṃ, Spk lll 241, 18 (= 'kaṭṭhānaṃ'); in cpd. v. l. for aranika-, Vin-vn 1810; — title of a sutta, SN V 211—13; — ifc. v. adharâ ° ( q. v., add Spk lll 241, 21 ; pt ad Sv (lll) 811, 27 , see arani-yugaḷa), uttarâ ° (MN l 240, 32 foll. = 11(93, 23 )152, 4 = lll 95, 5 ; Mil 53, 30 (= uturu-līya, Hīnaṭ); Ps ll 91, 9 ; Spk lll 241, 21 ; Vism 489, 21 - Vibh-a 80, 22 ).
